note: Forbidden: a reduced-size length on an address or dateTime IE. TestRFC7011NoReducedSizeForAddressOrTimestamp walks the counter, flow4 and flow6 templates and asserts IPv4 address IEs at 4, IPv6 at 16, dateTimeSeconds at 4 and dateTimeMilliseconds at 8 octets, red on any reduced length; every other exported IE is integral, for which reduced size is permitted. Single-polarity marker: no path applies reduced-size encoding.
